# P1.22 — Security hardening, pen test, launch verification

Spec: `docs/tickets/50_P1.22__security-hardening-and-launch-checks.md` · run ledger:
`docs/build/runs/P1.22.md`
**Stage A only** — the verification suite + audits + hardening at $0. Stage B (deploy + live legs:
canary-injection smoke, usercontent header checks, two-uid pod logs, backup/PITR verify, one
playbook drill — ≤$15, mostly $0) is operator-gated → `D-P1.22-2`. The external pen test is
operator-commissioned; Stage A ships the scope doc → `D-P1.22-3`. The §17 readout reports measured
build evidence and labels every prod-only metric UNMEASURED — nothing fabricated. The merge is
**operator-held**.

Stacks on `stevevitali/p1-21-protocols-2-4` (P1.21, PR #75).

## Summary

The final Phase-1 chain ticket turns "enforced, never advised" into an **executable** claim: a new
`@rhema/security-checks` package composes the audits — §12.8 injection controls (a)–(f) with planted
exfiltration fixtures, a `pg_catalog` tenancy census + pooled two-tenant probe, the usercontent/CSP
contract, the secrets/runtime posture, the retention/backup schedule, the IAM/RBAC surface, and the
REQ-EVAL-19 launch-surface lint — **102 checks, all green**.

**REQ-ARCH-32 landed for real:** the egress proxy's pause signals previously collected in memory and
dropped; migration `0041_pause_signals.sql` + `SqlSignalSink` + the worker's `drainPauseSignals`
sweep (5 s cadence, claim-lease + attempts cap, terminal-run idempotent) carry `suspicious_query` /
`egress_denied_spike` / `user_source_fetch` to a real `pauseRun` — `waiting_gate` + the
refusal-class card, exercised end-to-end through the SQL transport.

**IAM tightened (D-P0.01-5 closed in code):** the worker's `roles/container.developer` (could
create/delete clusters) is replaced by a custom IAMCustomRole carrying only
`container.clusters.get`/`list`, and `infra/k8s/30-worker-job-rbac.yaml` pins the in-cluster half —
the launcher identity can create/get Secrets + create/get/list Jobs in `runs`, nothing else. Both
apply at the next `pulumi up` / `apply.sh` (Stage B).

**P1.21 loose end closed:** `projects.protocol_overrides` was stored but never consumed — and neither
were the seeded protocols' own `phase_defaults` (e.g. Memo's `discourse:false`). Launch now resolves
the full layering — rigor defaults < seeded `protocol.phase_defaults` < stored `phaseDefaults` <
submitted toggles; `stage` falls back body→stored→protocol (`near-final`→`near_final`, `infer`⇒omit);
`length` freezes as `lengthTarget`; the sheet context returns both the overrides and per-protocol
defaults (booleans only — REQ-ARCH-33), and the sheet prefills against the selected protocol.
A malformed blob is ignored — never a launch failure.

**Observability (REQ-ARCH-34):** `packages/orchestrator/src/slo.ts` probes the nine DB-backed §13.5
signals every 5 min and logs `[slo] violation` lines; `infra/pulumi/monitoring.ts` turns them into a
labelled log metric + one AlertPolicy each + the api-availability `gcp.monitoring.Slo` + dashboard +
webhook channel. Two signals with no data path (`event_delivery` client-ack, `autosave` server-side
timing) report `unmeasured` — named gap `D-P1.22-1`, never fabricated. Five playbooks +
`slo-review.md` record the weekly-review / pause-on-breach rule.

**Docs:** `docs/security/pen-test-scope.md` (surface map, controls list, verbatim §14.7
residual-risk statement, triage protocol); `docs/security/usercontent-csp-audit.md`;
`docs/phase1-exit-readout.md` — the §17 criterion-by-criterion report.

## What changed

- **Pause transport:** `0041_pause_signals.sql` (system table, no RLS, claim lease + dead-letter);
  `apps/egress-proxy/src/signal-sink.ts` (`SqlSignalSink` — egress.denied → `run_events_internal`,
  pause → `pause_signals`); `drainPauseSignals` + `user_source_fetch` `PauseReason`; worker 5 s
  sweep; `pause_signals` Drizzle definition (schema parity).
- **`@rhema/security-checks`** (new, check-only): `injection-controls.test.ts` (15),
  `rls-catalog.test.ts`, `usercontent-csp.test.ts` (10), `secrets-manifests.test.ts` (11),
  `retention-backup.test.ts`, `infra-rbac.test.ts` (10), `launch-surface.test.ts` (26),
  `observability.test.ts` (13).
- **CSP:** api stamps `default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'` + nosniff on every response; web
  stamps a per-request-nonce CSP on HTML responses (scripts nonce-or-self only;
  `img-src` admits the usercontent origin; Set-Cookie survives the clone verbatim).
- **IAM/RBAC:** `infra/k8s/30-worker-job-rbac.yaml` + `apply.sh`; `infra/pulumi/iam.ts` custom role.
- **Overrides:** `run-routes.ts` (query + `projectProtocolOverridesSchema` + layering + frozen
  inputs), `sheet-context.ts`, `api-client` DTO, `web/server.ts` prefill.
- **Observability:** `slo.ts` probe + worker sweep + `monitoring.ts` + `docs/ops/slo-review.md` +
  `docs/ops/playbooks/{provider-outage,orphan-storm,cost-anomaly,boundary-violation,egress-denied-spike}.md`.
- **Docs/ledger:** `docs/security/*`, `docs/phase1-exit-readout.md`, `DEFERRALS.md` (D-P1.22-1..3;
  D-P0.01-5 DONE-in-code; D-P0.06-3 + D-P0.01-4 re-deferred with compensating controls).

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] §12.8 (a)–(f) executable across the surface incl. planted exfil fixtures + the
      `egress.denied`-spike pause end-to-end — deterministic leg green; **live smoke Stage B**.
- [x] Tenancy re-tested at full surface — `pg_catalog` census + pooled two-tenant probe.
- [x] usercontent/CSP audit written + asserted — **live header leg Stage B**.
- [x] Secrets sweep clean (committed tree); harness-uid posture asserted.
- [x] Retention/backup asserted against config — **live config leg Stage B**.
- [x] D-P0.01-5 resolved in code; D-P0.06-3 + D-P0.01-4 re-deferred with compensating controls;
      no OPEN Phase-1 row survives unowned (D-P1.22-1..3 named).
- [x] SLO dashboard + alert policies in IaC; five playbooks written; REQ-ARCH-34's rule recorded —
      **live delivery + drill Stage B**.
- [x] Launch-surface lint runs clean — zero comparative claims without the wave flag.
- [x] §17 Phase-1 exit readout written with evidence per criterion — nothing fabricated.
